name: Arctic Species Conservation Fund
summary: Small rolling grants for stewardship and research on Canadian Arctic wildlife and habitat, such as Indigenous protected area work, caribou and polar bear conflict projects, and marine mammal studies. Nunavut projects are prioritised.
reporting: Up to three items: an interim report after the first major milestone, communications media in some cases, and a final report with a financial statement.

status.quote: Proposals will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis at any point in the year.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants from all backgrounds (community groups, Hunters and Trappers Organizations, governments, universities, independent researchers, non-government organizations, etc.)

geography.quote: Projects can take place anywhere across northern Canada, though projects based in Nunavut will be prioritized.

access.quote: Applications should be submitted in PDF format to

window.quote: Proposals will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis at any point in the year.

amount.quote: Applicants can request up to $25,000 per year.
